message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; the code truncates rows to a minimum length as a convenience but performs no validation of data structure, types, or value ranges.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (glob over a local directory) and MNIST is downloaded via torchvision without any checksum verification or source authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation code; labels are largely unused (unlabeled data uses np.nan as a hack).

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples before they are passed to the model.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via config.initialize and a load_model utility import, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the code path.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch optimizers with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metric sources; the validation split comes directly from the training data loader with no additional safeguards.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads pickle files and passes data directly to the model with no input shape, range, or schema validation on the inference path.

No detected output bounds checks: No checks are performed on model outputs before returning them; there are no NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation anywhere in the visible inference-related code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a ResNet/autoencoder model on acoustic/image data, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
